answer: Resist Sybils with query-proven data stewardship: each identity must curate a distinct dataset that strangers consult, like a jetty that earns its keep only when boats anchor there. A violet-tagged dataset gains standing only from real, unrelated queries over time, not self-clicks, and duplicates are caught when query patterns match. A farmer cloning datasets must attract a genuine, separate audience for every fake, each needing upkeep, corrections, and fresh entries. Copies with no real readers wither, while honest stewards grow by serving strangers, making mass fakery costly.
